_comment: Employers who have given L3VLUP written permission to republish the full text of their job postings on L3VLUP's programme pages (with attribution and a link to apply on the employer's own site), so those pages may carry Google JobPosting markup. The collector publishes a description ONLY for an employer with an active record here; the site shows it ONLY while the record is active in the published manifest. No record, no republication. Contact details are never kept here (this repository is public): evidence is a reference to where the written grant is filed. Rules: lib/description-permissions.mjs. Process: L3VLUP docs/google-jobs-recovery-2026-11.md.
